steps.what: Recommend acceptance, rejection or compromise after weighing claims against applicable law and precedent

tasks.design: Keep outcome recommendations with the hearing officer using the case record and legal materials in {DOCS}. Search assistance alone is not credited with replacing legal judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: A recommendation requires weighing facts, legal interpretation and competing arguments.
tasks.enabler_now: Research tools exist, but their existence does not establish a saving in adjudicative judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving conflicting evidence and explaining why an outcome follows.
tasks.human_edge: Independent reasoning and accountability for the recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Improve the transparency of reasons and unresolved issues.

reach.learn: Distinguish factual disputes from legal interpretation

evidence.claim: Libra supports legal research and drafting; this capability does not establish autonomous claim outcome recommendations.
Keeping the outcome recommendation human produces no modelled labour saving in this task.

assumptions: The officer examines and clarifies the submitted record within s1; no eligibility or acceptance flag is supplied by an uncounted producer.
Any separate research task must own its own savings; no research baseline is invented here.
No new system is deployed and incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Authority boundaries between recommendation and final decision
research_questions: Which reasoning defects recur in reviewed recommendations?

incremental.description: No changed system or operating work

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100: all recommendation work remains human, with no gross or net saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Select appeals records and capture observed procedural events with source references
Group appeals events and calculate specified counts and intervals
Interpret studies, verify legal context and assess agency adherence and case determination obstacles

tasks.design: Configure native tables and formulas in {SPREADSHEET} for descriptive counts and elapsed intervals. The hearing officer selects and codes the evidence, then evaluates legal adherence in {DOCS}; no compliance determination is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Study evidence was repeatedly grouped and counted by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Native table formulas can rerun explicit descriptive calculations on checked events.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether practice conforms to law and whether observed delays have a justified cause.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret exceptions and distinguish correlation from a procedural defect.
tasks.altitude: Own a reproducible study method and defensible interpretation.

reach.learn: Record provenance and distinguish observations from conclusions

evidence.claim: Native tables can group checked procedural events without making a legal judgement; savings are an unmeasured task scenario.

assumptions: In s1 the officer produces case identifier, event type, observed event date, agency identifier, source reference and any explicitly recorded missing value; capture, coding and corrections are counted in 35 hours.
The officer also supplies grouping keys and interval pairs in s1. No structured adherence code or statutory deadline is assumed.
Missing dates remain missing and are investigated in s3; unusual studies use manual tabulation.
Native spreadsheet configuration comes before any custom application. Legal research and interpretation remain fully counted in s3.
Agency record retrieval remains in s1 rather than being transferred to uncounted staff.
unknowns: Quality and completeness of agency event records
Share of study time spent on repeatable tabulation
research_questions: Does checked tabulation save time after event coding and source verification are included?

already_counted.description: Evidence acquisition, field capture and interpretation

incremental.description: Formula upkeep and sample reconciliation to source records

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 task scenarios: B=100, R=75 gives 25 gross and 17 net after 8 focal upkeep hours. Range 0-4 reflects substantial coding and legal assessment, with no automated adherence decision.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Make evidence studies reproducible while retaining independent legal judgement.
reach: Help clerks distinguish observed events from conclusions about compliance
role.ambitious_version: A hearing officer who can audit the path from record to recommendation without delegating outcome judgement.

job.title: Administrative Law Judges, Adjudicators, and Hearing Officers
